caption: The drawing depicts a wooden drop-leaf table with a reddish-brown finish, showing wood grain and texture prominently on all surfaces. The tabletop is rectangular with rounded drop leaves on each side that hang vertically. The table is supported by two turned legs on either side, connecting to a lower flat shelf or stretcher. Each leg is joined to a pair of splayed feet, which are intricately carved and feature claw-like details, providing stability. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or decorative elements present, centering attention on the table itself.
title: Table-drop Leaf
